query: What human-in-the-loop thresholds (confidence cutoffs) and adjudication workflows should trigger manual review of automated Bloom-depth or topic assignments?

response.query: What human-in-the-loop thresholds (confidence cutoffs) and adjudication workflows should trigger manual review of automated Bloom-depth or topic assignments?
response.answer: Manual review of automated Bloom-depth or topic assignments should be triggered when confidence cutoffs are below 70% and ambiguous adjudication workflows are detected. Thresholds and workflows should be regularly updated based on performance metrics.
